Delta Air Lines had the **highest absolute revenue** ($61,643M), the **highest absolute operating income** ($5,995M), and the **highest operating margin** (~9.7%) of the five carriers in FY2024. Considering both scale (revenue and operating income) and profitability (margin), Delta stands out as the strongest overall performer in FY2024, with United as a strong runner-up on growth momentum.

ANSWER: Delta Air Lines
